pages.title: Cast
pages.text: Use three Raw Copper, a reusable fired Casting Mold, native furnace fuel, and explicit ignition. Blow Bellows to raise the ceiling from 800°C to 1150°C. At 1085°C or hotter, the Crucible Furnace casts one Copper Billet after 240 active ticks.

pages.title: Anneal
pages.text: Smelt the Cast Copper Billet in a normal furnace for 140 ticks to produce an Annealed Copper Billet. This transforms the item. A Kiln cannot anneal or smelt it.

pages.title: Forge
pages.text: Heat the annealed billet in a lit Kiln, transfer it to the Stone Anvil, and perform Flatten, Draw, Bend, Flatten while Workable. The result is a Copper Ingot. Cooling retains unfinished actions; reheat to resume.

pages.title: Use Copper
pages.text: Heat one Copper Ingot to at least 500°C in a Kiln, then forge Flatten, Draw, Bend on the Stone Anvil to make eight Copper Fasteners for the Quern. Copper and strong bindings make a Copper Knife. Primitive copper progression normally removes vanilla copper smelting/blasting bypasses.

pages.title: Forge Fasteners
pages.text: Input: 1 Copper Ingot. Output: 8 Copper Fasteners. Heat the ingot until Workable, then use a Stone Hammer for Flatten > Draw > Bend on the Stone Anvil. This is a forging recipe, not a crafting-table recipe. Unfinished work can be reheated without losing completed actions.
